protocol.selection: lexicographic: minimize number of development files undercounting reference participants, then weighted DER; freeze one configuration per model before evaluation
protocol.ru_gate: weighted DER at least 5 percent relatively lower than baseline; number of undercounted files not above baseline
protocol.natural_gate: weighted DER no more than baseline + 0.02 absolute
protocol.note: Engineering selection criteria fixed before evaluation, not official competition thresholds. Natural English data does not verify Russian podcast WER. No model training. All scoring collar 0, overlap included, 10 ms frames.

speaker_model.upstream_training_data_attribution: VoxCeleb; upstream pretrained.md also refers to CC BY 4.0 dataset terms

natural_source.selection: first six rows, crop at 120 seconds, use original author RTTM rather than repack labels
